description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Creatures in a 15-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save against your class DC or be dazzled for 1 round. At Magnesium Depth 3 a failure is blinded instead, and the flare deals fire damage equal to your level to creatures with light sensitivity or light blindness. At Depth 4 the emanation is 30 feet and counteracts magical darkness; once per day it may instead heal each ally within it for your level.
